about_the_game:
The Legend of Fengshen: Huang Feihu's Crossing of Five Levels "is a turn based battle game set against the backdrop of the classic mythological novel" Fengshen Yanyi ". In the game, players will take on the role of Huang Feihu, the King of Wucheng, and personally experience his legendary story of being forced to rebel against commerce due to the tyranny of King Zhou, and overcoming numerous obstacles to pass five levels. This DLC is not yet completed, currently 10 levels, and is being continuously updated.

Game background

Huang Feihu, angered by King Zhou's cruel treatment of his wife Jia and sister Huang Fei, turned against the Shang Dynasty and led his family to flee Chaoge. During the escape process, he needs to pass through five levels in a row: Lintong Pass, Tongguan Pass, Chuanyun Pass, Jiepai Pass, and Sishui Pass. Each level has powerful defenders and complex formations, and players need to use their intelligence and strategy to command Huang Feihu and his troops to overcome numerous obstacles.

Game Features

Highly restored to the original work: The game highly restores the classic plot and character settings of "Fengshen Yanyi", from Huang Feihu's anti business journey to the battles of various level guards, all strictly designed according to the original work.

Chess turn based gameplay: Players need to strategically layout on the battlefield, arrange the positions of generals and units reasonably, utilize terrain and unit restraint relationships, and develop the best combat strategy.

Rich characters and skills: In the game, there are not only Huang Feihu, but also his son Huang Tianhua, general Huang Ming, and many other characters to choose from, each with unique skills and attributes.

Diverse plot branches: Players' choices will affect the direction and ending of the game. For example, in the game of Jiepai, players can choose different strategies to deal with Huang Gun, the father of Huang Feihu, which will affect the subsequent plot.

Game experience

Players will experience intense and thrilling battles in the game, feeling the difficulties and choices of Huang Feihu in the anti business process. Every decision may affect the direction of the battle, and every battle requires careful planning. Whether facing Zhang Feng at Lintong Pass or Han Rong at Sishui Pass, players need to use their wisdom and courage to help Huang Feihu successfully flee to Xiqi.

Fengshen Zhuan: Huang Feihu Passes Five Levels "is not only a game, but also a new interpretation of classic mythological stories, allowing players to deeply experience the fantasy and charm of the Fengshen world in turn based chess gameplay.
